clue.text: So sure to find out

parts.note: so and as both work as 'to that degree' or 'because'

explanation.surface: Someone told to make certain of a fact before learning it.
explanation.definitionFit: To learn a fact for certain by checking is to establish it, a plain synonym.

clue.text: New Delhi's protection

indicators.note: new tells us the following letters are to be made into something fresh, a rearrangement

parts.note: the city name with its 's supplies six letters

explanation.surface: The Indian capital's defences, as a news item might put it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' looks like part of the place name New Delhi but is the anagram signal; the S of the possessive is part of the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A buckler carried in battle is a means of guarding the body, so it is a form of cover.

clue.text: Necessarily involve some recent ailments

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A diagnosis that has to cover a patient's latest complaints.
explanation.definitionFit: If one thing makes another unavoidable, it brings it along as a consequence.

clue.text: Right with four in the flourish

indicators.note: in says the right-plus-four pieces are placed inside the word the

parts.note: IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Instructions for a musical flourish: four bars played on the right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flourish' reads as a noun, a decorative flourish, but it is the verb meaning to prosper.
explanation.definitionFit: To grow vigorously or prosper is to do well, a verb synonym.

clue.text: It in short is a drink

explanation.surface: A note that 'It' is an abbreviation and names a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: In a 'gin and It', the It is short for this fortified wine, so the abbreviation itself is the first definition.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the bar abbreviation for the sweet red Italian fortified wine; that wine is also a drink in its own right.

clue.text: Lovesickness makes a chap a right pain

parts.note: he stands for any male, a chap

explanation.surface: Being lovesick turns a man into a proper nuisance.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'a' is a link word; 'a right pain' reads as British slang for an annoying person but splits into A, RT and ACHE.
explanation.definitionFit: The grief of unrequited love is emotional suffering, the same sense.

clue.text: Plan to put precious stone under layers of rock

indicators.note: in a down clue, under places the gem piece below the layers piece

parts.note: a gem is a precious stone

explanation.surface: A geologist's scheme to bury a jewel beneath the rock beds.
explanation.definitionFit: A cunning scheme or ruse is a kind of plan.

clue.text: Vegetarian's festive occasion?

parts.note: read literally, a vegetarian's feast would be made of pulses; really it is a jolly celebration of any kind

explanation.surface: A party for those who avoid meat.
explanation.definitionFit: A British colloquial word for a lively celebration or slap-up meal, historically an employer's annual dinner for workers.

clue.text: Nearly fixed the seat

indicators.note: nearly means the word is almost complete, losing its last letter

explanation.surface: A seat that was almost repaired.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nearly' removes the final D of SETTLED.
explanation.definitionFit: A long wooden bench with a high back is a type of seat.

clue.text: Two boys from the last century

parts.note: Ian is a second boy's name

explanation.surface: Two lads who came from an earlier era.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Two boys' gives two names, VICTOR and IAN. When the puzzle was set the 1800s were the last century, the reign of Queen Victoria.
explanation.definitionFit: Belonging to the reign of the queen who ruled Britain for most of the 1800s, which was the previous century then.

clue.text: Make a ministerial appointment

parts.note: suggests a prime minister choosing a cabinet, but means making someone a church minister

explanation.surface: A prime minister choosing a cabinet member.
explanation.definitionFit: To confer holy orders, making a person a priest or minister of the church.

clue.text: Quite fruitless when interrupt everybody in the vehicle

indicators.note: interrupt means one piece breaks into the middle of another

explanation.surface: Interrupting a busload of passengers achieves nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed clue has dropped the I; restored, I breaks into VAN to make VAIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Efforts that achieve nothing were wasted, futile in every way.

clue.text: Mother takes a long time to do some harm

parts.note: a dam is an animal's mother
an age is a long time

explanation.surface: A mother who dawdles before causing trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: DAM, the mother of an animal such as a horse, is a crossword favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: To injure or impair something is to hurt it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: One has double gin so shaken and is suffering

parts.note: a means one, as in a single thing

indicators.note: shaken, like a cocktail, means the letters are mixed up
double means the word gin is taken twice

explanation.surface: Someone downing a double gin to ease their pain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'double' gives GIN twice; with SO those letters, GINGINSO, are 'shaken' into GONISING after A.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in acute pain or distress, an adjective sense of tormented.

clue.text: Pass the time pleasantly when on holiday

parts.note: while can mean when, during the time that

explanation.surface: Relaxing on a vacation.
explanation.definitionFit: To spend spare hours in a relaxed, idle way is to kill time.

clue.text: Indicator of the pressure we are under

definitions.text: Indicator of the pressure we are under

parts.words: Indicator of the pressure we are under
parts.note: sounds like a measure of stress, but means the weight of air above us

explanation.surface: A gauge of how stressed we all are.
explanation.definitionFit: An instrument that measures atmospheric weight, the air that presses down on everyone.

clue.text: Final objective

explanation.surface: The last target.
explanation.definitionFit: The conclusion is the final part; an aim is a goal one is working towards.

clue.text: One other time

indicators.note: other says the letters are made into a different arrangement

explanation.surface: Another occasion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One other' reads as 'another'; 'other' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An age or vast span of history is a period of time.

clue.text: Moisture's payable, we hear

indicators.note: we hear says the word is identified by how it is spoken

parts.note: a bill that is payable is due

explanation.surface: Damp is owed money, someone hears.
explanation.definitionFit: Droplets forming on grass overnight are a form of condensation.

clue.text: Do a somersault when in love

explanation.surface: Tumbling over when smitten.
explanation.definitionFit: To flip upside down is a literal tumble; the same phrase means to be completely smitten.

clue.text: Additional points (not south)

indicators.note: not means the named letter is left out

explanation.surface: Extra points, except the southern one.
explanation.walkthrough: The four compass points spell NEWS; 'not south' removes S.
explanation.definitionFit: Something fresh can be extra or further, as in a further supply.

clue.text: Hold admiral

explanation.surface: Grab the naval commander.
explanation.walkthrough: A nelson is a wrestling hold; Horatio Nelson was the British admiral killed at Trafalgar.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrestling grip applied from behind the neck, and the surname of Britain's most famous naval commander.

clue.text: Take one's place on the parade ground and get soaked?

definitions.text: Take one's place on the parade ground

explanation.surface: Soldiers lining up and getting drenched.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is literal: to tumble into water.
explanation.definitionFit: A drill command to form ranks; also literally to tumble into water and be drenched.

clue.text: French son nearly allowed steak

indicators.note: nearly means the word loses its last letter

explanation.surface: A Frenchman's boy almost got permission to have beef.
explanation.definitionFit: A boneless cut of beef from the tenderloin, a type of steak.

clue.text: International body is performing in complete agreement

explanation.surface: A world organisation acting in harmony.
explanation.definitionFit: Perfect accord, everyone acting together, as in singing the same note.

clue.text: Although impetuous I am the one undergoing treatment

parts.note: I'm is short for I am
a patient is someone being treated

explanation.surface: An eager hospital case with no time to wait.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Although' is a link joining definition and wordplay, and the surface plays on a patient lacking patience.
explanation.definitionFit: Hasty or restless, unable to wait, the same sense as rash.

clue.text: Joins hands for a couple of moments!

explanation.surface: Clasping hands in just a moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In two shakes' is an idiom meaning very soon.
explanation.definitionFit: To clasp another's hand in greeting; also brief instants, as in 'two shakes of a lamb's tail'.

clue.text: Cowardly accepting the Italian as innocent

indicators.note: accepting means one word takes another into it

explanation.surface: A timid man taking in an Italian is found not guilty.
explanation.definitionFit: Free from blame or wrongdoing, blameless.

clue.text: Approached a revolutionary leader in distress

indicators.note: in says the first pieces go inside the word for distress
leader picks the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A rebel chief in trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: Came closer to, past tense of drew near.

clue.text: Consider large receptacle that provides advice and ideas

parts.note: a tank is a large container

explanation.surface: A big container that dispenses wisdom.
explanation.definitionFit: A body of experts that offers policy analysis and suggestions.
